about: A02 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a02studio
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. A stylized 3D animated character stands in a home photo studio on an old phone, its long coiled cord tangled around her arm, the wall calendar behind her covered in yellow sticky notes. She rolls her eyes and sighs. Then a thin bright ribbon of glowing lavender sparkles loops around her: the coiled cord untangles and drops loose, and the yellow sticky notes peel off the calendar one by one and flutter away out of frame like little birds, leaving the calendar clean. She hangs up the phone, beams and does a little fist pump. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm afternoon daylight from the window. Same face, same clothes, same room, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical, a weight lifted. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.

shots.name: a02m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a02diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. A small stylized 3D animated photographer in a cutaway dollhouse photo studio on a pale lavender backdrop raises her camera and takes a happy test shot, the softbox flashes softly once; a few tiny sticky notes float up and away above the room. The diorama does not change shape. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.
